exclusion_reason: No BPTK execution core exists to profile or optimize.
promotion_trigger: Promote when FIX-016 meets the exact startup, CPU, frame, audio, memory, code-cache, run-count, and variance threshold frozen by BPTK-002 without correctness regression.
expected_failing_assertion: No benchmarkable BPTK runtime can meet the first-playable performance budget.
active_gate_evidence: Upstream performance claim is not counted as BPTK performance evidence.
procedure: Profile the BPTK-002 run count of cold and warm executions on its frozen desktop hardware and browser profile.
Apply selected optimization and compare correctness, startup, frame, audio, memory, cache, percentile, and allowed variance to the frozen threshold.
pass_criterion: Every numeric BPTK-002 performance threshold passes across its precommitted run count and variance limit without correctness drift.
Profile evidence identifies the optimized hot path and invalidation behavior.
